notes.title: Patch v0.28.3
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENTS
-Library: You can now set sound files as favorites.
-General performance improvements.

FIXES: 
-Preview sounds are playing using the default output device even if a different output is selected.
-Bug fixes related to sound preview and output devices.
-Fixed some scrollbars with wrong scroll direction.
-Mixer: Sounds start playing at a different volume than the one selected at the sliders.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 0.26.3
notes.notes:
FIXES
-SFX Pad: Master volume and reverb can't be changed when using the default output device.
-SFX Pad: SFX Pad sounds stop when any property is changed in the SFX Pad section.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 0.21.7
notes.notes:
We temporarily disable the output device feature due to some bugs and artifacts it's causing. We are going to fix it and it will be re-enabled when it's fully functional and bug-free.

IMPROVEMENTS

 -Library: Now you can rename the content of the packs provided by RPG Sounds.

FIXES

 -Library: When searching files using the search field, you can't navigate through the text using arrows.
 -Library: After selecting a file in the Library when you start typing something in the search field it loses focus after the first letter.
 -Mixer: Sequence is repeating the file list twice.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 0.21.6
notes.notes:
FIXES
-Settings: Files are played with a strange reverb when using the player.
-Some dropdown aren't displaying the selected item.
-Fixed some typos.

notes.title: New update v0.21.5
notes.notes:
NEW

 -Settings: Now it's possible to change the output device.


FIXES

 -Sfx Pad | Mixer: It's not possible to drag files to individual slots.
 -Library: Cancel importing files creates an empty folder.
 -Settings: Adjusting the Resolution when not in fullscreen mode will cause the window to become very small and stay that.


Thanks for using RPG Sounds!

Feel free to join our discord community to ask questions, report bugs or give us suggestions: https://discord.gg/e4qhHKC

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 0.20.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue where the app was removing permanently files when deleting imported files. 
-Fixed an issue where sessions and presets bars are extended over the scrollbar.

notes.title: New release v0.20.0
notes.notes:
NEW RELEASE v0.20.0

Hi everyone!

We've been fixing a lot of bugs and implementing new cool features and improvements.

Also, you'll find that we added a sample session for the Tavern pack with two presets out of the box, hope you like it!

RELEASE NOTES
NEW
- Library:
-- Navigate using arrows.
-- Select and tag multiple files.
-- Copy/Cut and Paste selection.
-- Now it's possible to import folders.
-- Support for new file formats: mp2, aiff.
- Sessions: Pre-made sample Session using Tavern pack.

IMPROVEMENTS
- Preset Mixer: Delay interval assignation.
- Library: Selecting a filter now searches for ALL files with the tag.

FIXES
- Sessions: Error reading sessions data.
- Mixer: Saving preset resets the name of the preset to the previous name.
- Library:
-- Not possible to assign an image when a file has just been imported.
-- Root folder adopting the name of the last sub-folder renamed.
-- When a new image is imported, it replaces the image for all files inside the folder.

Thanks a lot for using RPG Sounds and for your feedback and patience!

notes.title: Quick update regarding Online Play
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is an update for Mac users. Now the Online Play is working and you should be able to stream your sessions to your remote players. 

We are working to fix the Online Play for Windows users. Thanks for your patience.
